description: §8.10.7/§14.8.9 — the same loop-hoist candidate with the SELECT narrowed to non-protected columns (`id, name`) fires no E-PROTECT-003: the projection carries no protected field. The clean control for the overlap reject. (S455, review P1: the loop is nevertheless NOT hoisted — a read over a table with any protected column keeps its per-iteration query so its rows pass the §14.8.9 strip; see protect/hoisted-loop-protected-table-not-hoisted-rt.)
rationale: §8.10.7: with the SELECT column list narrowed to non-protected columns there is no overlap with the target table's protected fields, so E-PROTECT-003 stays silent.
